33.    CONSIDERATION OF BIDS/PURCHASES/REQUESTS FOR PROPOSALS:

       b)     Consideration of Bid #S-20-26 for a Contract between the City of Cheyenne and
              Richardson Construction, Inc. for the Cheyenne Botanic Gardens           - Smith
              Education, Agriculture & Trial (E.A.T.) Garden. (Friends of the Botanic Gardens)

Mr. Moody moved to accept the bid in an amount not to exceed $854,892.21, seconded by Mr.
Wolfe. Motion carried by unanimous voice vote.

Jason Sanchez, Community Recreation & Events Director, provided a staff report. Randy Byers,
Cheyenne Botanical Gardens Foundation Chairman, provided additional information. Chairman
Esquibel and all committee members commented on the item. Additionally, Mr. Wolfe commented
on the use of electronic means for public comment. Public comment was made by Charles Miller,

At 1:32 p.m. following the vote on item #33(b), Mr. White excused himself for the remainder of
the meeting due to a previously scheduled work commitment.

       c)     Consideration of Bid #E-14-26 for furnishing Residential Automated Refuse Carts
              -95/65 Gallons, for the Sanitation Division. (Solid Waste Fund)

Mr. Moody moved to accept the bid from Rehrig Pacific Company, in an amount not to exceed
$204,884.00, seconded by Mr. Wolfe. Motion carried by unanimous voice vote.

Craig LaVoy, Public Works Deputy Director, provided a staff report.

       d)     Consideration of Bid #E- 15-26 for furnishing 1.5 Cubic Yard Rear-Load
              Dumpsters for the Sanitation Division. (Solid Waste Fund)

Mr. Wolfe moved to accept the bid from Kois Bros Equipment, in an amount not to exceed
$88,472.O0.00, seconded by Mr. Moody. Motion carried by unanimous voice vote.

Craig LaVoy, Public Works Deputy Director, provided a staff report.

       e)     Consideration of Bid #E-l7-26 for furnishing Bituminous Asphalt Hot Mix, Tack
              Oil, and Cold Mix on an annual basis, for the City of Cheyenne, Street & Alley
              Division. (2019-2022 Optional 1% Sales Tax Fund)

Mr. Moody moved to accept the bid from Simon Contractors for Bituminous Asphalt hot Mix and
Cold Mix in an amount not to exceed $495,750.00 and the bid from JTL Group Inc. d/b/a Knife
River for Tack Oil in an amount not to exceed $37,500.00 for a total of $533,250.00, seconded by
Mr. Wolfe. Motion carried by unanimous voice vote.

Vicki Nemecek, Public Works Director, provided as staff report and committee member Wolfe
commented on the item.
